versions.content: If NvMBswMMultiBlockJobStatusInformation is true, when a multiblock operation finishes or is canceled the NvM shall inform the BswM about the result of the multiblock operation, by calling the BswM_NvM_CurrentJobMode with the related multiblock request type and, as mode, the outcome of the multiblock operation.
